en: Panoramic sepia postcard showing a coastal town with dense low-rise buildings along a curved harbor, surrounded by hills. Sailing ships and small boats are moored in the bay and near a jetty or pier. Greek printed captions appear in small type near the top left and right, and there is a handwritten Greek message and date across the bottom margin. The image bears a watermark reading "www.elia.org.gr."
